ss1pwghs.baseName: COSTWAY 8FT Artificial Christmas Tree with Metal Stand - White
ss1pwghs.variantName: COSTWAY 8FT Artificial Christmas Tree with Metal Stand - White
ss1pwghs.sourceDescription: Are you looking forward to the upcoming winter season? This white Christmas tree is a great decoration to create a festive atmosphere! The Christmas tree features a collapsible design, which means the branches are attached directly to the tree, making it easier for you to assemble your tree with less effort. This artificial Christmas tree features 350/ 650/ 950/ 1138 beautiful tips that give it a full and realistic look. The sturdy metal stand and PVC plastic leaves are suitable for long-lasting use and allow you to place it indoors or outdoors, such as in a shop, office, living room, balcony or porch. Make your Christmas dream come true on any occasion! Elegant White Christmas Tree: This Christmas tree is pure white, which stands out from the traditional green Christmas trees. This elegant Christmas tree makes a beautiful backdrop for a winter wonderland. It suits both indoor and outdoor spaces and adds more excitement to your life. Flame-resistant and fluffy branches: The leaves of this Christmas tree are made of high-quality PVC material, flame retardant and odourless for unforgettable Christmas with peace of mind and joy. With 350/ 650/ 950/ 1138 branch tips that make the tree look more real and full, the Christmas tree mimics a full fir tree for a lively look. Easy to set up and store: It only takes a few minutes to set up and take down the Christmas tree, saving you time and effort. The collapsible composition can not only expand easily and makes the branches fluffy and lush. The Christmas tree can also be disassembled into several foldable parts for easy storage. Solid Metal Base: Thanks to the upright tree style in a lightweight size, the sturdy metal base is provided to give greater support. The metal base is designed to keep the tree stand tall and from tipping and tripping over the years. The plastic feet add stability and prevent scratches on the floor. Great Holiday Decoration: The artificial Christmas tree has a charming white color to give you romantic winter feelings. You can decorate the branches with Christmas ornaments as you like to spend quality time with your family and create great memories. It creates a festive atmosphere for Halloween, weddings, Valentine's Day, Christmas and other occasions. Specifications: Colour: White Material: PVC, metal From 5 ft to 8 ft Tree height: 150 cm/ 180 cm/ 210 cm/ 240cm Number of tips: 350/ 650/ 950/ 1138 Net weight: 2 kg/ 3 kg/ 4.5 kg/ 5.5 kg Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Is Assembly Required: Yes Package includes: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Instruction manual Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

r5rjp51w.baseName: Christmas Tree World 80cm Red Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
r5rjp51w.variantName: Christmas Tree World 80cm Red Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
r5rjp51w.sourceDescription: Introducing the 80cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Red, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. Product Features • Size: 80cm (other sizes available) • Colour: Red (other colours available) • Finish: High-gloss mirror effect • Material: Durable inflatable construction • Fire-resistant: Fire retardant material • Indoor & outdoor use • Installation options: Floor-standing, ceiling-hung, wall-mounted or secured to ground • Inflation: Inflated once and sealed no continuous air supply required • Storage: Fully deflates to take up minimal storage space • Pump: Electric air pump not included • Oversized gold bauble caps not included • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

yne54g50.baseName: Neo Willow Christmas Tree Skirt - Grey
yne54g50.variantName: Neo Willow Christmas Tree Skirt - Grey
yne54g50.sourceDescription: Add rustic charm to your festive display with this Neo Willow Christmas Tree Skirt, hand-woven from durable half-split willow. This decorative wicker tree collar neatly conceals your Christmas tree stand, base and trailing wires, creating a polished finish beneath your tree. The colour complements traditional and modern Christmas decorations, while the woven texture adds warmth and character. Measuring 45cm across the top, 65cm across the base and 28cm high, it is suitable for real or artificial Christmas trees with a compatible stand. The practical three-piece design clips together easily and folds flat for convenient storage between festive seasons. Hand-Woven Willow: Crafted from durable half-split willow with a textured wicker finish. Rustic Finish: Complements rustic, contemporary and traditional Christmas décor. Conceals Tree Stands: Creates a tidy display by hiding the tree base, stand and trailing wires. Easy Assembly: Three sections clip together effortlessly around your Christmas tree base. Compact Storage: Folds flat for easy storage and reuse year after year. Dimensions: Top diameter 45cm, base diameter 65cm and height 28cm. Check your tree stand dimensions before purchase. For decorative use only. This product is not a toy. Ensure all three sections are correctly assembled and securely connected using the supplied metal clips before use. Take care when attaching or removing the clips to avoid pinching fingers. Position the tree skirt on a firm, level surface and ensure it does not obstruct walkways or create a trip hazard. Keep the willow material away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other direct heat sources. Do not place hot items on or against the tree skirt. Keep metal clips and any small or detachable components out of reach of young children and pets due to potential choking or injury hazards. Regularly inspect the willow, edges and clips for damage, sharp points or loose components and discontinue use if damaged. Keep packaging materials away from children. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom
